question.text: The role of fluorspar, which is added in small quantities in the electrolytic reduction of alumina dissolved in fused cryolite is

options.text: to lower the melting temperature of the mixture
to decrease the rate of oxidation of carbon at anode

solution.text: Among the given statements (b) and (c) are correct these are the facts.
